legacy_inventory.ledger_status: four rows carry revision=1, product_target=unresolved, disposition=unresolved, implementation_status=unknown, authority_status=historical, consumer_refs=[]; empty consumer_refs are not evidence that consumers do not exist.

route_scope.owners: HELIX-OS is a mechanism, not a product; HELIX-HARNESS is an externally provided product and also part of the mechanism. World Governance source has unresolved product_target, therefore product-use predicates and internal governance-mechanism predicates remain distinct.
route_scope.security: SECURITY-008/009 are adopted operation-specific authority and incident/revocation predicates; semantic mention of policy/admission/permission alone is not a match.
route_scope.harness: HARNESS-006 is customer-facing service 1–7 release selection/state; it does not establish an internal World Governance registry/release owner. HARNESS process conditions and verification remain product scoped.
route_scope.L11: L11 locator columns are separate from L2 and refer only to acceptance predicates or asset-disposition rules.
route_scope.legacy_context: The archived HWG design names world graph/policy/admission, canonical JSON, old owners and old Issue/PLAN/PR arrangements. These are historical proposals. Old approval and architecture are not reused as current authority.
